description: This file defines the CpuVideoFrame class and related functions for handling YUV video frames, including conversion to RGB and creation of YV12 frames, with lookup tables for color conversion.

classes.name: CpuVideoFrame
classes.description: Represents a CPU-based video frame with YUV data, supporting conversion to RGB and creation of YV12 frames.

classes.name: CpuVideoFrame::Plane
classes.description: Represents a video plane with resolution, pitch, and data pointer.

methods.name: GetPlaneCount
methods.description: Returns the number of planes in the video frame.

methods.name: GetPlane
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific plane by index.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts a YV12 frame to BGRA32 format.

methods.name: CreateYV12Frame
methods.description: Creates a YV12 formatted video frame from raw Y, U, V data with specified bit depth.
